note: What the monthly Halal Maps job publishes (see places_data.py). Boxes are [south, west, north, east]. 'areas' come from Overture Maps: a metro area lists places marked halal plus often-halal cuisines as candidates for a person to sort; an area with marked_only lists only places marked halal, so it can be as large as a continent. regions keeps places whose address is in those states (a box around North Jersey also covers New York City); countries does the same by country code. 'osm' boxes are read from OpenStreetMap (diet:halal tags) once a month. The API treats any point inside an imported box as covered and never waits on a live map service there. To add a country: add its box to both lists.
